info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Parking Reservations Pricings-v1-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservations Pricing API allows businesses to access and list the current pricing information for parking reservations. This API is designed to help application developers integrate pricing data into their platforms, enabling users to view and compare parking costs easily. Common use cases include providing real-time pricing information for parking services and enhancing user experiences in booking applications. Consumers of this API typically include mobile app developers, website operators, and service aggregators in the transportation sector.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current pricing information for reservations. You can use this to determine the cost associated with making a reservation based on different criteria.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve pricing information for reservations. Ensure that the request contains all necessary parameters to receive accurate data.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the current pricing details for reservations.
